Hi Olivia —

Thanks again for the great conversation last week. As we prepare the case study page and a short partner spotlight, we'd love your permission to: 

- Use ClearGrid's horizontal color logo on the Redwood website (customer logos carousel + case study page)
- Publish a two-sentence testimonial attributing it to ClearGrid (format below)

Proposed quote (feel free to edit): 
"Redwood Inference helped us reduce inference cost by ~45% and made production latency predictable across peak hours — the rollout was smooth and the support team was excellent." — Olivia Chen, VP of ML, ClearGrid

Attached: proposed-quote-for-cleargrid.txt (editable), and our brand guidelines (redwood-brand-guidelines.pdf) so you can see where the logo will appear. If this looks OK, can you: 

1) Confirm the quote and preferred attribution line (job title/company name)
2) Confirm which logo variant we may use (horizontal full-color, stacked full-color, or single-color)
3) If required, loop in legal for a short release. We can route a DocuSign.

If easier, we're happy to send a one-page release for signature. Hoping to publish next week during our product update.

Thanks,
Marissa
